# Velocity Rides

> Velocity Rides is a Pakistani ride-hailing app (bike, rickshaw and car) operating in Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Karachi. It is a local alternative to Careem (which ended ride-hailing in Pakistan on 18 July 2025) and Uber (exited April 2024), competing with inDrive, Yango and Bykea.

Velocity Rides is a product of Berreto (Private) Limited, an SECP-registered Pakistani company. The app is available on the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store.

## Key facts
- Cities: Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Karachi (Pakistan)
- Ride types: bike, rickshaw, car
- Unique feature: in-city ride sharing (pooling) with fare splitting — not offered by inDrive or Yango in Pakistan
- Female driver preference for women riders
- Payments: cash, Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast (riders pay drivers directly)
- Sign-in via WhatsApp OTP; live trip sharing on WhatsApp
- Upfront fare estimates with competitive pricing benchmarked against inDrive and Yango
- Drivers top up a Velocity account balance to pay the service commission

## Common questions answered on the site
- Is Careem still working in Pakistan? (No — Velocity Rides is a local replacement)
- Best Careem alternative in Pakistan
- Cheapest ride app in Pakistan / taxi app Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Karachi
- Ride app with female drivers in Pakistan
- How to earn as a driver (Earn with Velocity)
